seed_scope: Two selected filename/hash rows from a public reputation platform's relation view, separately captured by the root investigator. The relation label is platform metadata, not our runtime observation.

known_case.hash_comparison_limit: The selected platform record and Island historical list agree. Current V1 archive bytes were not retrieved or hashed.

anonymous_case.observed: An AI security-skill repository had a README-only change redirecting one Markdown link and two bare URLs to an archive. The same skill directory contained SKILL.md in the pinned tree.
anonymous_case.baseline_relation: Its identity was absent from both fixed comparison lists; that does not establish prior non-disclosure or novelty.
anonymous_case.classification: Source pattern and file adjacency are confirmed. At the source-only pass close, current-byte equality was unverified; the separately recorded later root acquisition matched the platform file hash and pinned Git blob. Archive behavior, network behavior and owner intent remain unverified.
anonymous_case.identity_policy: Identity, exact source paths, filenames, hashes and identifying commit time are withheld pending owner review.

limits: Quoted filename searches locate text references, not archive bytes or a content-hash match.
Both SHA256 text searches returned zero indexed code hits. That is not proof that the files are unknown or absent from GitHub.
The reputation platform's relation/filename may refer to a differently named or earlier artifact. No archive bytes were fetched in this pass.
One case already appears in Island's published inventory; the other remains anonymous and receives no malware/actor verdict.
The anonymous queries are described and counted but their identifying literals are withheld, so that part is not fully reproducible from this public excerpt.
No common operator, active C2 communication, infection or exploitation is established.

later_static_phase.pe_access_limit: The first V2 inert PE member read returned a local OSError; the static reader stopped without retry or alternate access. No detection family was established.

publication_status: Prepared for owner review; not published.
phase_scope: Search and pinned-source observations on 2026-10-09. Later acquisitions and pure-data analyses are separately recorded in static-analysis.json; they do not retroactively change this source-pass denominator.

relation_capture.limits: Platform relationship metadata, not 547 campaign files, infections or independently observed communications. Two selected rows seeded the four separately counted searches. Unconfirmed identifying row data is withheld.
